repos.description: The open-source app everyone uses to manage agents at work
repos.hook: Paperclip helps you manage AI agents in one dashboard. An AI agent is a program that performs tasks on its own. You can track their tasks, view logs, and control access. The tool runs locally or on your servers.
repos.personalization: This gives you a fullstack TypeScript dashboard to monitor and evaluate autonomous coding agents in your workflow.

repos.hook: Hindsight gives AI agents long-term memory. It lets an agent learn from past conversations and mistakes. The agent stores facts and updates its knowledge over time.
repos.personalization: Useful for your prompt evaluation workflows when testing how well agents retain context over multiple runs.

repos.description: The design language that makes your AI harness better at design.
repos.hook: Impeccable is a design system made for AI coding tools. It provides design rules and prompts for AI models. This helps the AI write cleaner frontend code with better user interfaces.
repos.personalization: Helps you prompt coding assistants to build cleaner, more polished UI components for your fullstack side projects.

repos.description: VoiceStudio is the open-source, fully-local ElevenLabs alternative — voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription & audiobook creation in 646 languages.
repos.hook: VoiceStudio creates speech from text on your own computer. It can clone voices and translate spoken audio across 646 languages. You do not need to send your audio data to cloud providers.
repos.personalization: A solid local tool if you want to add Malay voiceovers or audio processing to your Islamic apps.

repos.description: Write HTML. Render video. Built for agents.
repos.hook: Hyperframes turns standard HTML and CSS into video files. You write layout code, and the engine renders it as video frames. AI agents can use it to generate programmatic videos quickly.

Effect is a TypeScript library for building reliable software. It helps you manage errors, handle async code, and structure large applications. It uses functional programming principles to make code predictable.
repos.personalization: Great for leveling up your fullstack TypeScript skills with strict type safety and structured error handling.

repos.description: Learn it. Build it. Ship it for others.
repos.hook: This repository teaches practical AI engineering. It contains step-by-step guides for building real AI applications. You learn how to work with models, build pipelines, and deploy systems.
repos.personalization: Directly aligns with your applied AI engineering work, covering hands-on implementation rather than pure academic theory.

repos.description: Give your AI agent eyes to see the entire internet. Read & search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, XiaoHongShu — one CLI, zero API fees.
repos.hook: Agent-Reach helps AI tools read content from social media platforms. It searches sites like Twitter, Reddit, and YouTube without paid API keys. Your agent receives clean text to use in prompts.
repos.personalization: Useful for gathering public sentiment or community discussions on Islamic finance and ethical tech topics.

repos.description: 380 Claude Code skills & agent skills & plugins (30+ Agents, 70+ custom commands, 380+ skills, customizable references, scripts)for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, and 8 more coding agents — engineering, marketing, product, compliance, C-level advisory, research, business operations, commercial & finance, and your daily productivity skills.
repos.hook: This repository provides over 380 plugins and prompt skills for AI coding tools. It includes ready-to-use workflows for Claude Code, Cursor, and other agent systems. You can add these skills to automate coding tasks.
repos.personalization: Directly relevant for evaluating and optimizing your Claude Code and Cursor developer setup.

repos.hook: T3 Code is a web-based code editor built for AI workflows. It lets developers collaborate with AI coding agents in a browser. The project is written in TypeScript.
repos.personalization: Worth evaluating as an open-source, fullstack TypeScript alternative to commercial AI coding environments.

repos.description: A smarter, self-hosted AI assistant — multi-user, multi-agent.
repos.hook: Octop is a self-hosted AI assistant platform. You run it on your own server to support multiple users and agents. It organizes conversations and coordinates tasks between different AI models.

repos.description: Domain-specific language designed to streamline the development of high-performance GPU/CPU/Accelerators kernels
repos.hook: TileLang is a programming language for writing custom GPU code. A GPU is a processor that handles fast parallel calculations. The tool helps developers write fast hardware kernels with simple syntax.

repos.description: 利用 AI 大模型和自动化工作流，根据主题或关键词一键生成高清短视频。Generate HD short videos from a topic or keyword with an automated AI workflow.
repos.hook: MoneyPrinterTurbo generates short video clips from a text topic automatically. It writes a script, creates voice audio, selects images, and stitches everything together. You can run the entire workflow locally.

Next.js is a popular framework for building fullstack web applications. It combines React frontend components with backend server routes. It handles page routing, server rendering, and asset optimization.
repos.personalization: A core framework for your fullstack web development and AI wrapper projects.

repos.description: Open Source Introductory Systems Programming Textbook for the University of Illinois
repos.hook: This repository contains an open textbook for systems programming. Systems programming means writing software that interacts directly with the operating system and hardware. It covers C programming, memory management, and threads.

repos.description: OpenShell is the safe, private runtime for autonomous AI agents.
repos.hook: OpenShell is a secure runtime environment for AI agents. A runtime is a system that executes programs. It isolates agent commands to keep your computer and private data safe during automated tasks.
repos.personalization: Essential to evaluate if you want safe, sandboxed execution when testing autonomous coding agents.

repos.description: yoink any video from your terminal. no shady ads.
repos.hook: Yoinks is a terminal command-line tool for downloading online videos. You paste a video URL in your terminal, and the tool saves the file. It operates without web advertisements or popups.

repos.description: Build your own network of agents from Claude Code, Codex and Pi: persistent teams with roles, shared context and owned work.
repos.hook: OpenRig coordinates teams of AI coding assistants like Claude Code. You assign specific roles and tasks to each agent. The agents share context and work together on software projects.
repos.personalization: Matches your workflow of testing multi-agent coordination with Claude Code and other coding assistants.

repos.description: Useful tool to track location or mobile number
repos.hook: GhostTrack is a command-line tool that looks up basic phone number and IP address information. It queries public telecom records and internet registers. It shows network carriers and general country locations.
